messages.subject: Reminder: Employment Law Update webinar — 9 April
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear colleagues,

A reminder that our quarterly Employment Law Update (worth 1.5 CPD hours) takes place on 9 April at 12:30. Topics include recent developments on settlement agreements, fire-and-rehire and the new duty to prevent sexual harassment. Register via the L&D portal.

L&D Team
